# U102: Rhea checks in with nothing due: with no set rhythm, the menu’s Check-in has no count; “Check in on a goal” lists her goals with no check-in this week first; checking in on one moves it to “Checked in this week”; nothing says how many are left or a streak

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `RHYTHM-OPTIONAL`, `UPDATE-ANYTIME`
- **Budget:** at most 10 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `parity` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U102

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Amara (an admin) sets no set rhythm; then, in the same browser (the demo keeps its data there), Rhea.
- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- Press the “Change” button in the rhythm row (`.rhythm-row`).
- Press the “No set rhythm” choice in the “Check-in rhythm” dialog.
- Press the “Save” button in the “Check-in rhythm” dialog.
- **Check:** “Check-ins have no set rhythm now.” is shown.
- Look as Rhea (`rhea`) in the workspace `platform-org` from here on, as choosing them in the Demo panel does (the browser’s storage: `goals-app-viewer:platform-org` is `rhea`).
- Go to `/check-in` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Check in on a goal” is shown.
- **Check:** “Check in when there’s news; nothing is due.” is shown.
- The visible menu's items: as their words (`menuWords`).
- **Check:** It fails if the menu’s Check-in has a count with nothing due: {item}.
- **Check:** (`entry`) met when `menu.some((t) => /^Check-in/.test(t))`, where `const menu = await menuWords(p, device)`. Else it says: no Check-in in the menu for an owner.
- **Check:** The “No check-in this week” part (`[data-part="No check-in this week"]`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `n > 0`, where `const waiting = p.locator('[data-part="No check-in this week"]')`; `const n = await waiting.locator('.ciq-row').count()`. Else it says: nothing listed under No check-in this week.
- **Step.** Press a link in a goal’s row in the check-in’s list (`.ciq-row`) in the “No check-in this week” part (`[data-part="No check-in this week"]`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/check-in/…”.
- **Check:** (`one-action`) scored as met here.
- _Note:_ Post it as the form asks: a number when it has one, a reason when one is asked for.
- Repeated, as the code loops:
  - If `i === 0 && await value.isVisible().catch(() => false)`:
    - **Step.** Type {await value.inputValue() || '1'} into the “This week’s value” field.
  - If `await why.isVisible().catch(() => false) && !(await why.inputValue())`:
    - Press the button in the cause pick, or the button (`.cause-pick button, [aria-label^="Why is it"] button`).
    - Type “Checking in with the latest number.” into the “What happened” field.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- If the address doesn’t match “/check-in”:
  - Go to `/check-in` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “Checked in this week” part (`[data-part="Checked in this week"]`) shows.
- **Check:** It fails if Check-in with no set rhythm says “{owed[0]}”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `moved > 0 && after === doneBefore + 1`, where `const waiting = p.locator('[data-part="No check-in this week"]')`; `const doneBefore = await p.locator('[data-part="Checked in this week"] .ciq-row').count()`; `const first = waiting.locator('.ciq-row').first()`; `const title = (await first.locator('.ciq-title').innerText()).trim()`; `const moved = await p.locator('[data-part="Checked in this week"]').getByText(title, { exact: false }).count()`; `const after = await p.locator('[data-part="Checked in this week"] .ciq-row').count()`. Else it says: {title} did not move to Checked in this week.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`logged`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
